Proposed Dashboard — Data, Provenance and Layout (6 Oct 2026)

/website/dashboard?version=proposed, Live + illustrative mode with provenance marks on, unless stated.

The whole page, desktop

Before: banner, illustrative hero figures, no Beneficiary Dashboard data. After: no banner; hero carries the Department's own figures (Received); new “Support to Students” movement; Funds movement adds the nine-scheme release.

Live mode — programmes with no live data

Before: DAPSC, SHRESHTA and Senior Citizens drawn as empty outlined cards. After: only programmes with figures are drawn, and the grid closes up.

Opening a chart's table

Before: “View as Table” expanded 36 rows under the map and pushed the layout down. After: a Chart / Table switch swaps the view in place; card height stays 1,047px, rows paged (1–33 of 36).

Per-100 measure

Before: “417 per 100 people” against Census 2011. After: “Outreach per 100 Residents” against the 2026 projection — Chandigarh 347; DNH & DD 140 (was 368).

Phone, 375px

Same structure on a phone; one column throughout.
